title: 计算机科学，从零搭建 · 第27部分：证明与随机性

chapters.Frontier: 15. 前沿：MIP* = RE 与实践中的证明
chapters.Outro: 回顾、习题，以及它们会在哪里再出现

6806858772d9.en: A proof can be more than a document read from beginning to end. This part studies three precise alternatives. <bookmark mark='a'/> A probabilistically checkable proof uses a robust encoding. True statements have an accepting proof; every proof of a false statement is rejected with bounded probability. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sum-check turns a claimed exponential sum into a conversation about low-degree polynomials over a finite field. Our small experiment checks complete transcripts; its sample frequencies do not establish the theorem. <bookmark mark='c'/> A zero-knowledge protocol can convince a verifier without revealing additional efficiently usable information about a secret colouring, under its stated definition and commitment assumptions. The graph and statement remain public. <bookmark mark='d'/> We will distinguish perfect completeness, soundness error, computational assumptions and actual finite measurements throughout.
6806858772d9.zh: 证明不必只是一份从头读到尾的文件。本部分研究三种精确的替代形式。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 概率可检验证明使用稳健编码。真命题有能被接受的证明；假命题的每一份候选证明，都以有界概率被拒绝。 <bookmark mark='b'/> Sum-check 把一个指数规模求和的声称，变成关于有限域上低次多项式的对话。我们检查小实验的完整记录；样本频率并不是定理的证明。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 零知识协议在精确定义和承诺假设下，能说服验证者，而不泄露关于秘密着色的额外可高效利用的信息。图与待证命题本身是公开的。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 我们会始终区分完美完备性、可靠性误差、计算假设和实际有限测量。

1ee7cde592b7.en: Part 27 of Computer Science, Built: Proofs and Randomness. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this part: the complexity classes of randomized algorithms, and why randomness may not add power after all; lower bounds for circuits, including the switching lemma, which we measure; communication between two parties; interactive proofs, from graph non-isomorphism to the sum-check protocol and IP equals PSPACE; zero knowledge; the PCP theorem, and why it makes approximation hard; the Unique Games Conjecture; fine-grained and parameterized complexity; counting; and a 2020 result connecting proofs with quantum entanglement and the halting problem.
1ee7cde592b7.zh: 计算机科学，从零搭建，第27部分：证明与随机性。<bookmark mark='a'/>这一部分包括：随机算法的复杂性类，以及为什么随机性也许终究不增加能力；电路下界，包括我们亲手测量的切换引理；双方之间的通信；交互式证明，从图非同构到 sum-check 协议与 IP 等于 PSPACE；零知识；PCP 定理，以及它为什么让近似变难；唯一博弈猜想；细粒度复杂性与参数化复杂性；计数；还有2020年一个把证明与量子纠缠和停机问题联系起来的结果。

39183bea0bdf.en: Randomized decision classes use probabilities over the algorithm’s own independent coins, for each fixed input. <bookmark mark='a'/> RP has polynomial worst-case running time, rejects every no-instance, and accepts each yes-instance with probability at least one half. Compositeness supplies an example. <bookmark mark='b'/> coRP reverses those roles: yes-instances always pass, and no-instances are rejected with probability at least one half. <bookmark mark='c'/> ZPP requires zero error and expected polynomial running time on every input. Randomized quicksort illustrates the Las Vegas style, although sorting itself is a function problem. <bookmark mark='d'/> BPP has polynomial worst-case running time and error at most one third on every input. Identity testing is a one-sided example within BPP. <bookmark mark='e'/> P is contained in ZPP, which equals the intersection of RP and coRP; these classes lie within BPP and PSPACE. <bookmark mark='f'/> None of these definitions averages over an input distribution. An adversary may choose the input.
39183bea0bdf.zh: 随机判定类的概率，针对每个固定输入，来自算法自身独立的随机比特。 <bookmark mark='a'/> RP 的最坏运行时间为多项式；每个否实例都被拒绝，每个是实例至少以二分之一概率被接受。合数判定是一个例子。 <bookmark mark='b'/> coRP 交换两种角色：是实例总被接受；否实例至少以二分之一概率被拒绝。 <bookmark mark='c'/> ZPP 要求零错误，并且每个输入上的期望运行时间为多项式。随机快速排序展示了拉斯维加斯式算法，但排序本身是函数问题。 <bookmark mark='d'/> BPP 的最坏运行时间为多项式，每个输入的错误率至多三分之一。恒等测试是其中一个单侧错误的例子。 <bookmark mark='e'/> P 包含于 ZPP，ZPP 等于 RP 与 coRP 的交；这些类包含于 BPP 和 PSPACE。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 这些定义都没有对输入分布取平均。输入可以由对手选择。

1ffb8748488e.en: Any fixed error bound below one half can be amplified. <bookmark mark='a'/> Run the algorithm independently an odd number of times and take the majority answer. <bookmark mark='b'/> The displayed binomial tail assumes each run errs with probability exactly one third; for smaller errors it is an upper bound. We evaluate this expression numerically and check it against exact rational sums. <bookmark mark='c'/> Hoeffding’s inequality gives the simpler upper bound exponential in minus the number of runs divided by eighteen. <bookmark mark='d'/> Thus a linear number of independent repetitions in the desired error exponent suffices; independence and a constant gap below one half are essential.
1ffb8748488e.zh: 任何严格小于二分之一的固定错误界，都可以被放大。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 独立运行算法奇数次，再取多数答案。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 图中的二项式尾部假设每次错误率恰为三分之一；错误率更小时，它是上界。这里数值计算该表达式，并用精确有理数求和核对。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Hoeffding 不等式给出更简单的上界：运行次数除以十八的负指数。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 所以，所需独立重复次数与目标错误指数呈线性关系。独立性和距离二分之一的常数间隔不可缺少。

f4b5a041fe09.en: Amplification also gives a nonuniform simulation of BPP. <bookmark mark='a'/> Reduce each fixed input’s failure probability below one divided by two raised to the quantity n plus one, using polynomially many independent runs. <bookmark mark='b'/> A union bound over all two-to-the-n inputs of length n makes the probability that a coin string fails on any of them less than one half. <bookmark mark='c'/> Hence at least one fixed coin string works for every input of that length. This is an existence argument. <bookmark mark='d'/> Hardwire that polynomial-length string into a polynomial-size circuit or advice string. The argument does not give a uniform efficient procedure for finding it. <bookmark mark='e'/> This proves BPP is contained in P over poly. The Sipser–Gács–Lautemann theorem separately places BPP in the second level of the polynomial hierarchy and its dual.
f4b5a041fe09.zh: 放大还给出 BPP 的非一致模拟。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 用多项式数量的独立运行，把每个固定输入的失败概率降到二的负 n 加一整体次方以下，即二的负括号 n 加一括号次方。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 对长度为 n 的全部二的 n 次方个输入取并集界，一串随机比特在任意输入上失败的概率便小于二分之一。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 因而至少有一串固定随机比特，对这个长度的每个输入都有效。这是存在性论证。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 把这条多项式长度字符串硬接进多项式规模电路，或者作为建议串。论证并未给出统一、高效地找到它的过程。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 这证明 BPP 包含于 P/poly。Sipser–Gács–Lautemann 定理另外把 BPP 放进多项式层级第二层及其对偶的交。

d8f17c7df9f4.en: The Nisan–Wigderson construction links circuit hardness with pseudorandomness. <bookmark mark='a'/> Apply a hard Boolean function to overlapping subsets of a random seed. The subset system must satisfy quantitative design bounds. <bookmark mark='b'/> The picture is schematic: small overlaps alone do not prove that arbitrary output bits are independent. The theorem controls distinguishability by circuits of a specified size. <bookmark mark='c'/> A hybrid argument converts a successful distinguisher into a circuit predicting the hard function; suitable hardness amplification supplies the needed average-case hardness. <bookmark mark='d'/> Under sufficiently strong, efficiently evaluable hardness assumptions, the seed can be logarithmic in the simulated input length. Enumerating all seeds then yields deterministic polynomial-time simulation.
d8f17c7df9f4.zh: Nisan–Wigderson 构造把电路难度与伪随机性联系起来。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 对随机种子的多个重叠子集计算一个困难布尔函数。子集系统必须满足定量的组合设计界。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 这张图是示意图。重叠小，并不直接证明任意输出位相互独立；定理控制的是指定规模电路的区分能力。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 混合论证把成功的区分器变成预测困难函数的电路；适当的难度放大提供所需的平均情形难度。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 在足够强、而且函数可高效求值的难度假设下，种子长度可对模拟输入长度取对数。枚举所有种子，便得到确定性多项式时间模拟。

b1a435adc900.en: General arithmetic-circuit identity testing remains a central derandomization problem. The Vandermonde formula is a known identity used to illustrate the randomized test. <bookmark mark='a'/> Evaluating a determinant and its product expression at a point avoids explicitly expanding all factorially many permutation terms. The recorded timings measure this implementation on this host. <bookmark mark='b'/> Over a prime field, a nonzero polynomial of total degree d has at most d divided by the field size probability of vanishing at uniformly independent coordinates. The field and formal-polynomial assumptions matter. <bookmark mark='c'/> We retain every sampled point and compare both true and deliberately false expressions with an independent native computation. Zero observed false passes is a finite sample result. <bookmark mark='d'/> The open problem concerns general circuit representations with suitable degree and field access, not this specific identity, which has a deterministic proof.
b1a435adc900.zh: 一般算术电路的恒等测试，是去随机化的核心问题。范德蒙德公式是一个已知恒等式，这里用来说明随机测试。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 在一个点上计算行列式和乘积表达式，可以避免显式展开阶乘数量的排列项。记录的耗时针对本机上的这个实现。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 在素数域上，总次数为 d 的非零多项式，在各坐标独立均匀取样时，取零的概率至多是 d 除以域大小。域和形式多项式的假设很重要。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 我们保留每个采样点，并用独立本地程序核对正确表达式和故意改错的表达式。没有观察到误过关，只是有限样本结果。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 未解问题针对具有适当次数和域访问条件的一般电路表示，而不是这个已有确定性证明的具体恒等式。

aac01e144b48.en: Hardness and derandomization have precise conditional connections. <bookmark mark='a'/> Impagliazzo and Wigderson showed that if some language in E, deterministic time two to a constant times n, requires exponential-size Boolean circuits, then P equals BPP. <bookmark mark='b'/> This is a circuit-hardness assumption with a particular quantitative strength, rather than a consequence of P differing from NP alone. <bookmark mark='c'/> Kabanets and Impagliazzo connected suitable deterministic identity testing over integer arithmetic circuits to a disjunction of new Boolean or arithmetic circuit lower bounds. <bookmark mark='d'/> These implications connect different problems; they do not establish an unrestricted equivalence between all lower bounds and all derandomization. <bookmark mark='e'/> Primality provides a concrete success: the AKS algorithm places it in deterministic polynomial time. <bookmark mark='f'/> Efficient probabilistic tests remain useful in practice; this engineering comparison depends on the algorithms and input sizes.
aac01e144b48.zh: 难度与去随机化之间，有精确的条件联系。 <bookmark mark='a'/> Impagliazzo 与 Wigderson 证明：若 E 中某个语言需要指数规模布尔电路，即某个确定性二的常数倍 n 次方时间语言具有这种难度，则 P 等于 BPP。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 这是一项有特定定量强度的电路难度假设，不是仅由 P 不等于 NP 推出的结论。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Kabanets 与 Impagliazzo 把适当的整数算术电路确定性恒等测试，与新的布尔或算术电路下界的析取联系起来。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 这些蕴含连接不同问题，并没有建立所有下界与所有去随机化之间的无条件等价。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 素性判定是具体成功：AKS 算法把它放进确定性多项式时间。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 高效概率测试在实践中仍然有用；这种工程比较取决于算法和输入规模。

e41f51b50f99.en: Circuits give a sufficient route to separating P from NP. <bookmark mark='a'/> P over poly allows a nonuniform family, with one circuit per input length and a common polynomial size bound. <bookmark mark='b'/> Every P language and, by Adleman’s argument, every BPP language has such a family. <bookmark mark='c'/> Proving SAT has no polynomial-size circuit family would imply P differs from NP, and would establish the stronger statement that NP is not contained in P over poly. It is a sufficient route, not an equivalence. <bookmark mark='d'/> Karp and Lipton showed that if NP were contained in P over poly, the polynomial hierarchy would collapse to its second level. <bookmark mark='e'/> These implications explain the interest in circuit lower bounds while retaining the natural-proof and other barriers discussed in Part 26. <bookmark mark='f'/> The following chapters study restricted circuit classes, for which lower bounds are known under their precise model assumptions.
e41f51b50f99.zh: 电路给出分离 P 与 NP 的一条充分路线。 <bookmark mark='a'/> P/poly 允许非一致电路族：每个输入长度一张电路，整个族受同一个多项式规模界限制。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 每个 P 语言，以及由 Adleman 论证得到的每个 BPP 语言，都有这种电路族。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 若证明 SAT 没有多项式规模电路族，就能推出 P 不等于 NP，并得到更强的 NP 不包含于 P/poly。这是一条充分路线，并非等价。 <bookmark mark='d'/> Karp 与 Lipton 证明，若 NP 包含于 P/poly，多项式层级就坍缩到第二层。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 这些蕴含解释了电路下界的重要性，同时仍保留第26部分讨论的自然证明等障碍。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 下面研究受限电路类；对这些类，可以在精确的模型假设下证明下界。

b6b27cb0700e.en: Johan Håstad's tool is the random restriction. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is a formula in disjunctive normal form: twenty terms, each the AND of three literals, OR-ed together, over fourteen variables. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fix each variable to a random value, except that with probability p it stays free. <bookmark mark='c'/> Most terms die: one false literal kills a term. If any term becomes true, the whole formula is true. <bookmark mark='d'/> What survives is tiny. This restriction leaves a function that a decision tree of depth two computes.
b6b27cb0700e.zh: Johan Håstad 的工具是随机限制。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是一个析取范式的公式：二十个项，每项是三个文字的与，再把它们或起来，共十四个变量。<bookmark mark='b'/>把每个变量固定为一个随机值，只是以概率 p 让它保持自由。<bookmark mark='c'/>大多数项死掉了：一个假文字就能杀死一项。只要有一项变真，整个公式就为真。<bookmark mark='d'/>剩下的东西非常小。这个限制留下的函数，用深度为二的决策树就能计算。

55991d787215.en: This experiment fixes one width-three DNF and samples restrictions independently. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each variable is left free with probability p; otherwise it is fixed to a fair Boolean value. We retain every actual restriction and compute the exact minimum decision-tree depth of its resulting truth table. <bookmark mark='b'/> The switching lemma bounds the probability of depth at least t by five p times the width, raised to t, in this standard formulation. The bound can be vacuous when it exceeds one. <bookmark mark='c'/> A shallow decision tree yields a small-width CNF, explaining the switch between OR-of-ANDs and AND-of-ORs. <bookmark mark='d'/> Iterating carefully chosen restrictions controls fixed-depth circuits. Parity on the remaining free variables still has decision-tree depth equal to their number; it becomes constant if none remain. <bookmark mark='e'/> The finite table illustrates this mechanism. Håstad’s lower-bound theorem, with fixed circuit depth and its quantitative parameters, is a separate asymptotic result.
55991d787215.zh: 这个实验固定一份宽度为三的 DNF，并独立采样限制。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 每个变量以概率 p 保持自由，否则被公平固定成布尔值。我们保留每份实际限制，并从所得真值表计算精确的最小判定树深度。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 标准形式的切换引理，把深度至少为 t 的概率，上界为五乘 p 乘宽度的 t 次方。该值大于一时，上界没有信息。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 浅判定树给出小宽度 CNF，这解释了或连接合取与合取连接或之间的切换。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 精心迭代限制，可以控制固定深度电路。剩余自由变量上的奇偶函数，判定树深度仍等于自由变量数量；没有自由变量时，它会变成常数。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 有限表格只是机制的示例。Håstad 的下界定理，带着固定电路深度和定量参数，是另一个渐近结论。

bfec579b1ac8.en: Other circuit models require their own exact restrictions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Parity lower bounds hold for constant-depth AND, OR and NOT circuits; Razborov and Smolensky extend the method to modular gates over a fixed prime characteristic different from the target parity modulus. <bookmark mark='b'/> Monotone-clique lower bounds exclude negation and depend on the clique-size regime. They must not be transferred to unrestricted Boolean circuits. <bookmark mark='c'/> Williams proved that NEXP has no polynomial-size nonuniform ACC-zero circuit family, with fixed depth and fixed allowed modular gates. His algorithm-to-lower-bound connection is a theorem about those circuit classes, not a solution of P versus NP.
bfec579b1ac8.zh: 不同电路模型，需要各自精确的限制。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 奇偶函数下界适用于常数深度的与、或、非电路；Razborov 与 Smolensky 把方法扩展到固定素数特征的模门，而特征须与目标奇偶模数不同。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 单调团下界排除了取反，并且依赖团大小所处的参数范围。不能直接套到不受限布尔电路。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Williams 证明 NEXP 没有多项式规模、非一致、固定深度且使用固定模门的 ACC 零电路族。算法到下界的联系，是关于这些电路类的定理，不是 P 与 NP 问题的解答。

bb7628f9612d.en: Equality illustrates how randomness can reduce communication. Assume equal-length n-bit strings and a prime field. <bookmark mark='a'/> Alice chooses a uniform field element, evaluates her string polynomial there, and sends the point and value. Bob evaluates his own polynomial at that point. This is a private-coin one-way protocol. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each field element uses the ceiling of log base two of the field size bits. The large-input rows are analytic communication bounds, not experiments on trillion-bit inputs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Equal strings always agree. For unequal strings, the difference polynomial has degree at most n minus one, so the error is at most that degree divided by the field size. Every actual sampled challenge is retained. <bookmark mark='d'/> Deterministic equality needs linear communication in the standard model. Randomization trades this communication for explicitly bounded one-sided error.
bb7628f9612d.zh: 相等判定展示随机性如何减少通信。假设两串等长，都是 n 位，并且使用素数域。 <bookmark mark='a'/> Alice 均匀选择一个域元素，在该点评估自己的字符串多项式，把点与值发给 Bob。Bob 在同一点计算自己的多项式。这是私有随机、单向通信协议。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 每个域元素需要域大小以二为底对数向上取整的位数。大输入行是解析通信界，不是对万亿位输入做过实验。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 相等串总是一致。不等串的差多项式次数至多 n 减一，因此错误率至多为次数除以域大小。每个实际采样挑战都被保留。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 在标准模型中，确定性相等判定需要线性通信；随机性用明确有界的单侧错误，换取通信量的减少。

b60cfbe61d3f.en: How do you prove that a protocol needs many bits? <bookmark mark='a'/> Write the function as a matrix, Alice's input for the row, Bob's for the column. A protocol that exchanges c bits cuts this matrix into at most two to the c rectangles, each constant. <bookmark mark='b'/> For equality the matrix is the identity. No rectangle can contain two diagonal ones, because a rectangle containing x, x and y, y also contains x, y, which is zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> So two to the n rectangles are needed, and n bits. <bookmark mark='d'/> Linear algebra gives the same bound through the rank of the matrix. <bookmark mark='e'/> Some functions resist even randomness. Deciding whether two sets intersect needs a linear number of bits, randomized or not. <bookmark mark='f'/> And whether the logarithm of the rank always predicts the true cost, up to a polynomial, is the log-rank conjecture, open since 1988.
b60cfbe61d3f.zh: 怎样证明一个协议需要很多位？<bookmark mark='a'/>把函数写成矩阵，Alice 的输入作行，Bob 的作列。一个交换 c 位的协议把这个矩阵切成至多二的 c 次方个矩形，每个矩形取值不变。<bookmark mark='b'/>对相等问题，矩阵是单位阵。没有哪个矩形能包含两个对角线上的一：包含 x, x 和 y, y 的矩形也包含 x, y，而那里是零。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以需要二的 n 次方个矩形，也就是 n 位。<bookmark mark='d'/>线性代数通过矩阵的秩给出同样的界。<bookmark mark='e'/>有些函数连随机性也对付不了。判定两个集合是否相交需要线性多位，不论随机与否。<bookmark mark='f'/>而秩的对数是否总能在多项式意义上预测真实代价，就是对数秩猜想，自1988年起悬而未决。

8b8e66f10f9f.en: Communication lower bounds explain some streaming-space limits. <bookmark mark='a'/> In a one-pass protocol, Alice processes the first portion of a stream and sends its memory state to Bob, who processes the rest. A streaming algorithm using s bits therefore yields a one-way communication protocol using s bits. <bookmark mark='b'/> For a suitably encoded disjointness problem over a growing universe, this yields linear worst-case space bounds even with bounded error. <bookmark mark='c'/> Exact distinct counting and higher frequency moments have hard instances in the relevant models. The first frequency moment in an insertion-only stream is simply the stream length and needs only a counter. <bookmark mark='d'/> The Alon–Matias–Szegedy results establish specific approximation and space trade-offs, rather than a universal lower bound for every statistic. <bookmark mark='e'/> HyperLogLog and Count-Min choose approximation to obtain useful small-space guarantees. The pass count, update model, universe size and desired error remain part of each statement.
8b8e66f10f9f.zh: 通信下界解释了某些流式空间限制。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 在单遍协议中，Alice 处理流的前一部分，把内存状态发给 Bob，由他处理剩余部分。因此，用 s 位内存的流式算法，给出通信 s 位的单向协议。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 对增长的取值域上适当编码的不相交问题，即使允许有界错误，也能推出最坏情形的线性空间界。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 精确不同元素计数和更高阶频率矩，在相应模型中有困难实例。但仅插入流的第一频率矩，就是流长度，只需要计数器。 <bookmark mark='d'/> Alon–Matias–Szegedy 的结果建立具体的近似与空间权衡，并非每种统计量的通用下界。 <bookmark mark='e'/> HyperLogLog 与 Count-Min 选择近似，以得到有用的小空间保证。遍数、更新模型、取值域大小和误差要求，仍是结论的一部分。

7a041fef48c0.en: How do you prove that two graphs are different? For sameness, the matching of vertices is a short certificate. For difference, none is known. But a conversation works. <bookmark mark='a'/> The verifier flips a coin, picks one of the two graphs, scrambles its vertex labels, and shows the result to the prover. <bookmark mark='b'/> The prover, who has unlimited computing power, says which graph it came from. <bookmark mark='c'/> The verifier accepts if the answer matches the coin. <bookmark mark='d'/> If the graphs really differ, the prover can always tell, and our honest prover was right every time. <bookmark mark='e'/> If they are the same, the scrambled graph carries no information about the coin, and the prover can only guess: forty-nine percent in our two thousand rounds. <bookmark mark='f'/> Twenty rounds push a bluffer's chances below one in a million. <bookmark mark='g'/> Interaction has proved something no known written proof can.
7a041fef48c0.zh: 怎样证明两个图是不同的？要证明相同，顶点的对应关系就是一份简短的证书。要证明不同，还不知道有什么证书。但一场对话可以做到。<bookmark mark='a'/>验证者抛一枚硬币，选出两个图之一，打乱它的顶点标号，把结果给证明者看。<bookmark mark='b'/>拥有无限计算能力的证明者说出它来自哪个图。<bookmark mark='c'/>答案与硬币一致，验证者就接受。<bookmark mark='d'/>如果两个图真的不同，证明者总能分辨，我们诚实的证明者每次都答对了。<bookmark mark='e'/>如果它们相同，打乱后的图不带有关于硬币的任何信息，证明者只能猜：在我们的两千轮里是百分之四十九。<bookmark mark='f'/>二十轮就能把虚张声势者的机会压到百万分之一以下。<bookmark mark='g'/>交互证明了一件已知的书面证明都证明不了的事。

e03304d04c8d.en: IP formalizes interactive proofs with a probabilistic polynomial-time verifier and a computationally unbounded prover. <bookmark mark='a'/> The conversation has polynomially many rounds and polynomial communication. <bookmark mark='b'/> Completeness says that for a true input there exists a prover strategy making the verifier accept with probability at least two thirds. <bookmark mark='c'/> Soundness says that for a false input every prover strategy is accepted with probability at most one third. The input is fixed; probability is over verifier randomness. <bookmark mark='d'/> Goldwasser, Micali and Rackoff introduced the framework together with zero knowledge. <bookmark mark='e'/> Babai’s Arthur–Merlin protocols expose the verifier’s random coins. Constant-round AM is distinguished from the full polynomial-round class. <bookmark mark='f'/> Goldwasser and Sipser showed that private coins can be replaced by public coins with controlled round overhead; allowing polynomially many rounds preserves the power of IP. <bookmark mark='g'/> NP is the one-message deterministic-verification special case. IP equals PSPACE, but a strict separation between NP and IP has not been proved.
e03304d04c8d.zh: IP 把交互式证明形式化：验证者是概率多项式时间算法，证明者不受计算能力限制。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 对话有多项式数量的轮次，通信量也为多项式。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 完备性说：对真输入，存在一种证明者策略，使验证者至少以三分之二概率接受。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 可靠性说：对假输入，每种证明者策略的接受概率都至多三分之一。输入固定，概率来自验证者的随机性。 <bookmark mark='d'/> Goldwasser、Micali 与 Rackoff 在引入这一框架时，也提出了零知识。 <bookmark mark='e'/> Babai 的 Arthur–Merlin 协议公开验证者的随机比特。常数轮 AM 要与完整的多项式轮类区分。 <bookmark mark='f'/> Goldwasser 与 Sipser 证明，可用受控的轮数开销，把私有随机换成公开随机；允许多项式轮时，IP 的能力保持不变。 <bookmark mark='g'/> NP 是一次消息、确定性验证的特例。IP 等于 PSPACE，但 NP 与 IP 的严格分离尚未证明。

3e76321339af.en: Chapter six. Sum-check and IP equals PSPACE.
3e76321339af.zh: 第6章。Sum-check 与 IP 等于 PSPACE。

4862b96e21ac.en: Arithmetization converts a Boolean formula into a polynomial. <bookmark mark='a'/> Negation becomes one minus the variable; conjunction becomes multiplication; a clause becomes one minus the product of the false-literal indicators. <bookmark mark='b'/> On Boolean points this polynomial equals the formula. Summing over the Boolean cube therefore gives its satisfying-assignment count modulo the field characteristic. <bookmark mark='c'/> We use the prime field of ninety-seven elements. For this formula each variable occurs at most once per clause, so five is a valid individual-degree bound. Our implementation also handles repeated occurrences by enlarging that bound. <bookmark mark='d'/> The example has seven satisfying assignments, smaller than ninety-seven, so no ambiguity from modular counting arises. <bookmark mark='e'/> In general, a modulus larger than the possible count, or additional reconstruction information, is needed to recover the integer count. The protocol itself verifies a field-valued sum.
4862b96e21ac.zh: 算术化把布尔公式变成多项式。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 取反变成一减变量，合取变成乘法；一个子句变成一减所有假文字指示量的乘积。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 在布尔点上，这个多项式等于公式。因此，对布尔立方体求和，给出满足赋值数量对域特征取模后的结果。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 这里用九十七元素的素数域。本公式在每个子句中，每个变量至多出现一次，所以五是有效的逐变量次数界。实现还会为重复出现的变量增大该界。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 这个例子有七个满足赋值，小于九十七，不会因模计数产生歧义。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 一般要恢复整数计数，需要模数大于可能的计数，或者有额外的重建信息。协议自身验证的是域上的和。

3ff69c158cf2.en: The verifier reduces the claimed sum one variable at a time. <bookmark mark='a'/> In each round the prover sends a univariate polynomial as six values at distinct field points, fixing a degree-at-most-five polynomial. <bookmark mark='b'/> The values at zero and one must add to the current claim. Only after receiving the message does the verifier draw an independent uniform challenge and update the claim by interpolation. The table contains the actual retained transcript. <bookmark mark='c'/> After four rounds, the verifier evaluates the original arithmetized formula at the four challenges and compares it with the final claim. <bookmark mark='d'/> Communication and verifier arithmetic are polynomial in the number of variables, the degree bound and field-element bit length. This teaching Lagrange evaluator performs degree-dependent work; the prover still does exponential suffix summation.
3ff69c158cf2.zh: 验证者逐个变量缩减求和声称。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 每轮，证明者用六个不同域点上的值，发送一个逐次至多五的单变量多项式。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 零与一处的值之和，必须等于当前声称。验证者先收到消息，再抽取独立均匀的挑战点，用插值更新声称。表格保留了实际对话。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 四轮之后，验证者在四个挑战点组成的位置计算原始算术公式，并与最后声称比较。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 通信量和验证运算，对变量数、次数界和域元素位长为多项式。这里的拉格朗日求值确实依赖次数；证明者仍执行指数规模的后缀求和。

47879c7d993d.en: Soundness concerns every prover strategy, including adaptive ones. <bookmark mark='a'/> If the current claim is false, any polynomial that passes the sum-at-zero-and-one check must differ from the true polynomial. <bookmark mark='b'/> Two distinct polynomials of degree at most d agree at no more than d field points. <bookmark mark='c'/> Therefore, conditioned on any earlier transcript where the claim is still false, the next independent uniform challenge repairs that false claim with probability at most d divided by the field size. <bookmark mark='d'/> If no round repairs it, the final direct evaluation rejects. A union bound gives n d divided by the field size; a sequential conditional argument also gives one minus one minus d over p to the n. Independence between success events is unnecessary. <bookmark mark='e'/> Our specific cheating strategy adds a polynomial with chosen roots. Its measured frequency comes from three thousand trials, with ordinary sampling uncertainty. It is not a counterexample when a sample proportion lies above a theoretical probability bound. <bookmark mark='f'/> A larger field lowers the soundness bound. No observed success in three hundred trials remains a finite observation, not zero soundness error.
47879c7d993d.zh: 可靠性针对每种证明者策略，也包括自适应策略。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 如果当前声称为假，任何通过零与一处求和检查的多项式，都必须与真实多项式不同。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 两个不同的、次数至多为 d 的多项式，至多在 d 个域点上一致。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 因而，只要在此前对话条件下声称仍为假，下一个独立均匀挑战把假声称修复为真的概率，至多为 d 除以域大小。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 若每轮都没有修复，最后直接求值便拒绝。并集界给出 n 乘 d 除以域大小；逐步条件论证还给出一减一减 d 除以 p 的 n 次方。无需假设成功事件互相独立。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 我们的具体作弊策略，加入带指定根的多项式。测得的频率来自三千次试验，具有普通抽样不确定性。样本比例高于理论概率界，并不构成反例。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 增大域，会减小可靠性界。三百次试验没有观察到成功，仍然只是有限观察，不等于可靠性误差为零。

6a077f015918.en: This was a breakthrough. <bookmark mark='a'/> Sum-check shows that counting solutions has interactive proofs, far beyond NP. <bookmark mark='b'/> Weeks later Adi Shamir extended it to quantified formulas: a for-all becomes a product, an exists becomes one minus a product, and the same round-by-round checking works. <bookmark mark='c'/> A trick to keep the degree low makes it go through n quantifiers. <bookmark mark='d'/> In the other direction, an optimal prover can be simulated in polynomial space. <bookmark mark='e'/> So IP equals PSPACE: a polynomial-time verifier with coins can be convinced of anything provable in polynomial space, such as who wins a board game from a given position. <bookmark mark='f'/> And the proof does not relativize: there are oracles relative to which it is false. It was the first major technique to get past Part 26's first barrier.
6a077f015918.zh: 这是一个突破。<bookmark mark='a'/>Sum-check 表明，计数解的个数也有交互式证明，远远超出 NP。<bookmark mark='b'/>几周后，Adi Shamir 把它推广到量化公式：全称变成乘积，存在变成一减乘积，同样逐轮检查的办法依然管用。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个保持次数很低的技巧让它能通过 n 个量词。<bookmark mark='d'/>反方向上，最优的证明者可以在多项式空间里模拟。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以 IP 等于 PSPACE：一个带硬币的多项式时间验证者，可以被说服相信任何能在多项式空间里证明的事，比如从给定局面出发谁能赢一盘棋。<bookmark mark='f'/>而且这个证明不可相对化：存在预言机，相对于它这个结论不成立。它是第一个越过第26部分第一道障碍的重大技术。

76f376985101.en: Here is the classic story. <bookmark mark='a'/> A cave is shaped like a ring, with a door at the back that opens only with a secret word. <bookmark mark='b'/> Peggy walks in by one of two paths while Victor waits outside. Then Victor shouts which path she should come back by. <bookmark mark='c'/> If she knows the word, she can always comply, opening the door if needed. If not, she is caught half the time. <bookmark mark='d'/> After twenty rounds, a bluffer survives with probability one in a million. <bookmark mark='e'/> And Victor learns nothing about the word. He could have produced an identical video with an actor who doesn't know it, by simply editing out the failed rounds. <bookmark mark='f'/> That is the definition of zero knowledge: whatever the verifier sees, he could have simulated himself.
76f376985101.zh: 这是一个经典故事。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个山洞呈环形，后面有一扇门，只有念出秘密口令才能打开。<bookmark mark='b'/>Peggy 从两条路之一走进去，Victor 在外面等着。然后 Victor 喊出她应该从哪条路回来。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果她知道口令，总能照办，必要时打开那扇门。如果不知道，她有一半的时候会被抓住。<bookmark mark='d'/>二十轮之后，虚张声势者存活的概率是百万分之一。<bookmark mark='e'/>而 Victor 对口令一无所知。他本可以找一个不知道口令的演员拍出一模一样的视频，只要把失败的回合剪掉。<bookmark mark='f'/>这就是零知识的定义：验证者看到的一切，他都能自己模拟出来。

9bbd0b52dae6.en: Goldreich, Micali and Wigderson obtained zero-knowledge proofs for NP using suitable commitments and reductions. Here is the three-colouring teaching protocol. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every round freshly permutes the three colours. <bookmark mark='b'/> The prover commits to each vertex using a salted hash. Binding and hiding require computational assumptions; a fixed hash and a seeded Python generator do not supply an unconditional security theorem. <bookmark mark='c'/> The honest verifier uniformly selects an edge only after commitments have been sent. <bookmark mark='d'/> The prover opens the endpoint commitments, and the verifier checks both hashes and the two colours. Our full public commitment and opening records are retained. <bookmark mark='e'/> Different colours pass; equal colours fail. Fresh independent rounds amplify soundness under the commitment assumptions. The public graph and the claim of colourability are already known to the verifier.
9bbd0b52dae6.zh: Goldreich、Micali 与 Wigderson 借助适当的承诺和归约，得到 NP 的零知识证明。这里演示三着色协议。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 每轮都重新随机置换三种颜色。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 证明者用带随机盐的哈希承诺每个顶点。绑定性和隐藏性需要计算假设；固定哈希与带种子的 Python 随机生成器，并不提供无条件安全定理。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 诚实验证者在收到承诺后，才均匀选择一条边。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 证明者打开两端承诺，验证者核对哈希与颜色。完整公开承诺和打开记录都被保留。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 颜色不同则通过，相同则失败。在承诺假设下，新鲜独立轮次会放大可靠性。公开图和可着色声称，本来就为验证者所知。

b2feb9191f9b.en: The measured cheating experiment fixes an invalid colouring rather than solving a cryptographic attack. <bookmark mark='a'/> The supplied colouring has two bad edges among fifteen. <bookmark mark='b'/> With independent uniform edge challenges and binding commitments, it survives k rounds with probability thirteen fifteenths to the k. The table compares two thousand actual trials with this exact finite model. <bookmark mark='c'/> A colouring with only one bad edge has the weaker survival bound one minus one over the number of edges, raised to k. <bookmark mark='d'/> Three hundred and one rounds put that bound below one in a billion. These probabilities assume correct commitment binding and independent challenges; our seeded experiment demonstrates the mechanics.
b2feb9191f9b.zh: 这个作弊实验固定一份无效着色，而不是执行密码攻击。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 给定着色的十五条边中，有两条坏边。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 在独立均匀边挑战和绑定承诺下，撑过 k 轮的概率为十五分之十三的 k 次方。表格把两千次实际试验，与这个精确有限模型比较。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 若只有一条坏边，较弱的存活界是一减边数倒数的 k 次方。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 三百零一轮使该界低于十亿分之一。这些概率假设承诺正确绑定、挑战相互独立；带种子的实验只是演示机制。

1b0b899bf4ba.en: The histogram measures one carefully limited part of the verifier’s view. <bookmark mark='a'/> For a valid colouring and a fresh uniform colour permutation, the two opened endpoint colours form a uniform ordered pair of distinct colours. <bookmark mark='b'/> A simulator can sample that pair distribution without knowing the colouring. This equality is exact for the marginal distribution. <bookmark mark='c'/> Six thousand real and simulated pair samples fluctuate around one sixth for each ordered pair. Their empirical similarity alone is not a proof of zero knowledge. <bookmark mark='d'/> A complete zero-knowledge argument must simulate commitments, openings, verifier randomness and the full interaction. It uses the commitment assumptions and, for arbitrary verifiers, the appropriate simulator and rewinding analysis. <bookmark mark='e'/> Fiat–Shamir can remove interaction from suitable public-coin protocols under additional security conditions. It is not a universal transformation from any proof into a secure signature. Our exercise is explicitly a transcript-bound teaching demonstration.
1b0b899bf4ba.zh: 这张直方图测量的是验证者视图中一个受限的部分。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 对有效着色和新的均匀颜色置换，打开的两个端点颜色，构成均匀分布的有序异色对。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 模拟器无需知道着色，也能采样这个颜色对分布。对这个边缘分布而言，相等是精确的。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 六千个真实与模拟颜色对样本，各自在六分之一附近波动。经验上的接近，本身并不是零知识的证明。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 完整零知识论证必须模拟承诺、打开信息、验证者随机性和整个交互。它依赖承诺假设；对任意验证者，还需要合适的模拟器和回绕分析。 <bookmark mark='e'/> Fiat–Shamir 可在附加安全条件下，为适当的公开随机协议去掉交互。但它不能把任意证明普遍变成安全签名。这里的习题明确只是绑定对话记录的教学演示。

2838861b12ee.en: The PCP theorem is a statement about specially encoded proofs and precise acceptance probabilities. <bookmark mark='a'/> A polynomial-time verifier uses logarithmically many random bits and queries a constant number of bits of a polynomial-length proof. <bookmark mark='b'/> For each true input there exists a proof accepted with probability one. <bookmark mark='c'/> For each false input every purported proof is accepted with probability at most one half. This does not promise to detect every isolated changed bit. <bookmark mark='d'/> Arora and Safra, and Arora, Lund, Motwani, Sudan and Szegedy established the theorem; later work refined its parameters. <bookmark mark='e'/> Håstad’s three-query refinement has completeness arbitrarily close to one and soundness just above one half. The near-perfect completeness qualifier matters; it cannot simply inherit the preceding perfect-completeness statement.
2838861b12ee.zh: PCP 定理讨论特别编码的证明，以及精确的接受概率。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 多项式时间验证者使用对数数量的随机比特，对多项式长度的证明，只查询常数个位。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 对每个真输入，存在以概率一被接受的证明。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 对每个假输入，每份候选证明的接受概率都至多二分之一。这不保证发现每一个被孤立改动的位。 <bookmark mark='d'/> Arora 与 Safra，以及 Arora、Lund、Motwani、Sudan、Szegedy 建立了这一定理；后续工作改进了参数。 <bookmark mark='e'/> Håstad 的三次查询改进，完备性可以任意接近一，可靠性误差略高于二分之一。近乎完美完备性的限定很重要，不能直接继承上一条的完美完备性。

cbed3c68af75.en: The BLR test provides an executable local-testing example, rather than a complete PCP construction. <bookmark mark='a'/> The target is a linear Boolean function: parity of a subset of the input bits, including the zero function. A constant-one offset is not linear in this convention. <bookmark mark='b'/> Draw x and y independently and uniformly, then test whether f of x plus f of y equals f of x exclusive-or y, with output addition in the field of two elements. <bookmark mark='c'/> Linear functions always pass. <bookmark mark='d'/> We retain each full eight-bit truth table and compute both its exact rejection probability and its distance to the nearest linear function. Independent Walsh-spectrum identities check both results. <bookmark mark='e'/> The curve three delta minus six delta squared is a lower bound in its stated distance range, not an asserted exact value for every corrupted function. Our exercise exhaustively determines all four-bit minima. <bookmark mark='f'/> Local robustness is a component used in PCP constructions; this experiment does not by itself establish the PCP theorem.
cbed3c68af75.zh: BLR 测试给出一个可执行的局部测试例子，而不是完整的 PCP 构造。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 目标是线性布尔函数，也就是某个输入位子集的奇偶函数，包括零函数。按这里的约定，带常数一偏移的函数不叫线性函数。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 独立均匀抽取 x 和 y，检查 f 的两值之和，是否等于 x 与 y 异或处的函数值；输出加法在二元素域中进行。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 线性函数总能通过。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 我们保留每份八位输入的完整真值表，精确计算拒绝率和距离最近线性函数的距离，并用独立 Walsh 谱恒等式核对。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 三 delta 减六 delta 平方的曲线，是指定距离范围中的下界，不是每个受损函数的精确值。习题还穷举了四位函数的所有最小值。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 局部稳健性是 PCP 构造的一个组成部分，这个实验本身并不证明 PCP 定理。

bf02ce839bde.en: Dinur’s combinatorial PCP proof amplifies a constraint-satisfaction gap. This panel is an outline of its ingredients. <bookmark mark='a'/> A constraint graph represents a verifier: an assignment to its labels must satisfy all constraints in a yes-instance. <bookmark mark='b'/> Initially, a no-instance may force only an inverse-polynomial fraction of constraints to fail. <bookmark mark='c'/> Expander-based powering increases a sufficiently small gap by a controlled constant factor; it also changes the alphabet and graph size. <bookmark mark='d'/> Alphabet reduction and composition control that growth. These steps require careful completeness and size analysis; the gap does not double without limits. <bookmark mark='e'/> After logarithmically many amplification stages, the no-instance has a constant unsatisfied fraction while the total construction remains polynomial. <bookmark mark='f'/> This gives the PCP theorem through a combinatorial route. We illustrate the proof architecture rather than execute a full PCP reduction here.
bf02ce839bde.zh: Dinur 的组合 PCP 证明，会放大约束满足问题的间隙。这一面板只是主要组成部分的提纲。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 约束图表示一个验证者：在是实例中，某种标号赋值满足全部约束。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 起初，否实例可能只强迫多项式倒数量级的约束失败。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 基于扩展图的幂运算，把足够小的间隙放大受控的常数倍，同时也改变字母表和图大小。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 字母表缩减与组合控制这种增长。这些步骤要仔细分析完备性和规模；间隙不能无限翻倍。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 经过对数数量的放大阶段，否实例中不能满足的比例变成常数，而总构造规模仍为多项式。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 这是一条组合方式的 PCP 定理证明路线。这里展示证明架构，并没有实际运行完整 PCP 归约。

1904a532c1f1.en: PCPs imply hardness of approximation through a gap-preserving reduction. <bookmark mark='a'/> Encode each verifier acceptance test as a bounded-arity constraint, with proof bits serving as assignment variables. <bookmark mark='b'/> Perfect completeness gives an assignment satisfying every constraint in a yes-instance. <bookmark mark='c'/> Soundness bounds the fraction that any assignment can satisfy in a no-instance, leaving a constant gap. Conversion to a particular clause format may change that constant. <bookmark mark='d'/> An approximation strong enough to distinguish the two cases would solve the original NP-hard decision problem. The objective, reduction, completeness and soundness parameters determine the actual approximation threshold.
1904a532c1f1.zh: PCP 通过保持间隙的归约，推出近似困难性。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 把验证者的每个接受测试编码成有界元数约束，以证明位作为赋值变量。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 完美完备性保证是实例中，某个赋值满足全部约束。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 可靠性限制否实例中任何赋值能满足的比例，留下常数间隙。转换成特定子句格式时，常数可能改变。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 若某种近似足以区分两种情形，就能解决原来的 NP 难判定问题。实际近似门槛由目标、归约、完备性和可靠性参数共同决定。

aef624a1086f.en: Consider MAX-E3SAT with three distinct variables in each clause. <bookmark mark='a'/> A uniform random assignment satisfies each such clause with probability seven eighths, so linearity of expectation guarantees that fraction on average. Conditional expectation can derandomize this guarantee. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our finite random formulas and bounded WalkSAT runs are retained in full. Their better scores concern this sample distribution and do not improve a worst-case approximation guarantee. <bookmark mark='c'/> Håstad proved that for every fixed positive epsilon, distinguishing satisfiable instances from instances with optimum at most seven eighths plus epsilon is NP-hard. <bookmark mark='d'/> Consequently, a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm beating that threshold would imply P equals NP. Randomized algorithms require the corresponding randomized complexity qualification. Sampling success on easy instances does not establish such a uniform algorithm.
aef624a1086f.zh: 考虑每个子句含三个不同变量的 MAX-E3SAT。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 均匀随机赋值满足每个这种子句的概率为八分之七，因此期望的线性性保证平均满足这一比例。条件期望方法可以去随机化这个保证。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 我们完整保留有限随机公式和有预算的 WalkSAT 运行。较高分数针对这个样本分布，并没有改进最坏情形近似保证。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Håstad 证明，对每个固定的正 epsilon，区分可满足实例与最优值至多八分之七加 epsilon 的实例，是 NP 难的。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 所以，突破该门槛的确定性多项式时间算法会推出 P 等于 NP。随机算法需要相应的随机复杂性限定。容易实例上的采样成功，并不建立这种统一算法。

599ff05334e1.en: Compare approximation thresholds only for the stated optimization problems and models. <bookmark mark='a'/> MAX-E3SAT has the seven-eighths guarantee. The MAX-E3LIN result instead concerns distinguishing almost-satisfiable linear systems from systems whose optimum is near one half; exactly satisfiable linear systems are solved by elimination. <bookmark mark='b'/> Set-cover hardness has logarithmic dependence on the universe size. Clique hardness gives an n to the one-minus-epsilon barrier, while the trivial n approximation is merely a simple baseline, not the best known algorithm. <bookmark mark='c'/> Vertex cover and MAX-CUT retain gaps between unconditional algorithms and known hardness. The next chapter explains which sharper barriers would follow from the Unique Games Conjecture.
599ff05334e1.zh: 比较近似门槛时，必须使用各自指定的优化问题和模型。 <bookmark mark='a'/> MAX-E3SAT 有八分之七保证。MAX-E3LIN 的结果则区分近乎可满足线性系统，与最优值接近二分之一的系统；完全可满足的线性系统可由消元求解。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 集合覆盖的困难性依赖取值域大小的对数。团问题有 n 的一减 epsilon 次方障碍；平凡的 n 近似只是一条简单基线，并非已知最佳算法。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 顶点覆盖和最大割的无条件算法，与已知困难性之间仍有间隙。下一章解释，唯一博弈猜想会推出哪些更强障碍。

ea5c5f16cfe5.en: Chapter ten. The Unique Games Conjecture.

80ec146561a8.en: A general unique game assigns labels from a finite alphabet, and each directed edge specifies a permutation relating its endpoint labels. <bookmark mark='a'/> Knowing one endpoint label uniquely determines the other. The drawing and experiment use the special case of cyclic shifts modulo k. <bookmark mark='b'/> For a satisfiable connected instance, choose a root label, propagate along a spanning tree, and check every remaining edge. General permutation games may require trying each possible root label. <bookmark mark='c'/> The Unique Games Conjecture says that for every positive completeness and soundness tolerance, some sufficiently large fixed alphabet makes distinguishing almost-satisfiable instances from instances with very small optimum NP-hard. <bookmark mark='d'/> The hard distinction is approximate satisfiability. It does not contradict the easy test for fully satisfiable games, and the planted shift instances are not a general hardness experiment.
80ec146561a8.zh: 一般唯一博弈使用有限字母表上的标号，每条有向边指定一个置换，把两端标号联系起来。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 知道一端标号，就能唯一决定另一端。图与实验使用的是模 k 循环移位这一特例。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 对可完全满足的连通实例，选定根标号，沿生成树传播，再检查其余边。一般置换博弈可能需要尝试每个根标号。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 唯一博弈猜想说：对任意正的完备性和可靠性容差，总有足够大的固定字母表，使区分近乎可满足实例，与最优值很小的实例成为 NP 难问题。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 困难之处是近似可满足性。这不违背完全可满足博弈的简单检验；植入移位实例也不是一般困难性实验。

a67ce4f9c419.en: This finite experiment plants a labelling on a connected simple graph, then corrupts a specified number of edge shifts. <bookmark mark='a'/> We retain all three thousand vertices, nine thousand distinct edges and seven-symbol labels. Ten chosen roots supply the displayed best propagation score. <bookmark mark='b'/> With no corrupted edges, propagation satisfies every constraint. <bookmark mark='c'/> After corruption, a spanning-tree mistake can spread through a subtree. The planted labelling’s displayed score is a lower bound on the true optimum, not a computed optimum certificate. <bookmark mark='d'/> The random baseline now uses independent label draws from one seeded generator per trial. An earlier implementation reset the generator at every vertex and produced constant labels; that original data is preserved. <bookmark mark='e'/> These finite results compare two heuristics on one planted model. General unique-game approximation theorems and conjectured worst-case hardness use their own promises and alphabet parameters.
a67ce4f9c419.zh: 这个有限实验在连通简单图上植入标号，再改坏指定数量的边移位。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 我们保留三千个顶点、九千条不同的边和七符号标号。表格取十个指定根中最好的传播分数。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 没有损坏边时，传播满足每条约束。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 损坏之后，生成树上的错误可能影响整棵子树。植入标号的分数，只是真实最优值的下界，不是已经算出最优值的证书。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 修复后的随机基线，每次试验用一个带种子的生成器独立抽取各顶点标号。旧实现在每个顶点重置生成器，产生常量标号；旧数据已保留。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 这些结果比较的是同一植入模型上的两种启发式方法。一般唯一博弈近似定理和最坏情形困难性猜想，各自带有承诺和字母表参数。

4bd78fdff61e.en: The consequences below are conditional on the Unique Games Conjecture, except where a separate theorem is explicitly stated. <bookmark mark='a'/> It would make improving vertex cover below factor two by any fixed positive constant NP-hard. <bookmark mark='b'/> It would make the Goemans–Williamson MAX-CUT approximation constant optimal up to arbitrarily small additive error in the appropriate worst-case sense. <bookmark mark='c'/> Raghavendra’s theorem concerns each fixed finite-domain, bounded-arity MAX-CSP: a canonical semidefinite relaxation and rounding achieve its optimal approximation threshold under the conjecture. It does not cover every optimization problem. <bookmark mark='d'/> Subexponential algorithms solve certain near-satisfiable unique-game promises with parameter-dependent runtimes. They neither refute the conjecture nor establish P equals NP. <bookmark mark='e'/> The Grassmann-graph and two-to-two games results establish related hardness theorems with different completeness promises. <bookmark mark='f'/> In particular, the known unique-game hardness regime with completeness near one half must not be confused with the conjecture’s near-one completeness requirement. <bookmark mark='g'/> These are precise conditional and partial results; our planted seven-label experiment decides none of the outstanding worst-case questions.
4bd78fdff61e.zh: 以下结论以唯一博弈猜想为条件；另有定理时，会明确区分。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 它会使比二更好任意固定正常数的顶点覆盖近似成为 NP 难。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 在适当的最坏情形意义下，它会使 Goemans–Williamson 的最大割近似常数最优，只容许任意小的加性误差。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Raghavendra 定理针对每个固定有限域、有界元数的 MAX-CSP：在猜想下，标准半定松弛与舍入达到其最优近似门槛，并非覆盖所有优化问题。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 亚指数算法解决某些近乎可满足的唯一博弈承诺，其运行时间依赖参数。它们既不推翻猜想，也不证明 P 等于 NP。 <bookmark mark='e'/> Grassmann 图和二对二博弈的结果，建立了带不同完备性承诺的相关困难性定理。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 特别是，已知唯一博弈完备性接近二分之一的困难区间，不能混同于猜想要求的接近一的完备性。 <bookmark mark='g'/> 这些是精确的条件结论和部分结果。七标号植入实验，无法决定那些最坏情形未解问题。

3d5106b089f9.en: NP-hardness alone does not prove an exponential lower bound. Fine-grained hypotheses ask more specific questions about achievable exponents. <bookmark mark='a'/> SETH says that for every fixed positive epsilon, some fixed clause width rules out a two-to-the-one-minus-epsilon-times-n SAT algorithm in the specified deterministic model. <bookmark mark='b'/> The 3SUM and APSP hypotheses concern fixed exponent improvements over quadratic and cubic time, with input and machine models stated. Logarithmic speedups do not refute them. <bookmark mark='c'/> Split a sparse bounded-width SAT instance’s variables into two halves. Each partial assignment becomes a vector whose coordinates identify clauses it fails to satisfy. <bookmark mark='d'/> Two vectors are orthogonal exactly when their combined assignment satisfies every clause. Under the dimensional and polynomial-overhead conditions, a fixed exponent improvement for the relevant OV family would refute SETH. <bookmark mark='e'/> The three hypotheses are distinct conditional assumptions. Their reductions and precise variants must be stated rather than treating all fast-problem lower bounds as one conjecture.
3d5106b089f9.zh: 单有 NP 难性，并不证明指数下界。细粒度假设针对可达到的指数，提出更具体的问题。 <bookmark mark='a'/> SETH 说：对每个固定正 epsilon，总有某个固定子句宽度，排除在指定确定性模型中，以二的一减 epsilon 乘 n 次方时间解决 SAT。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 三数和与全对最短路假设，分别针对相对平方和立方时间的固定指数改进，同时要说明输入和机器模型。对数加速并不推翻它们。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 把稀疏、有界宽度 SAT 的变量分成两半。每个部分赋值变成向量，其坐标标记未被该半赋值满足的子句。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 两个向量正交，当且仅当合并赋值满足全部子句。在维数和多项式开销条件下，对相应正交向量族的固定指数改进，会推翻 SETH。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 这三个假设是不同的条件假设。要逐一说明归约及其精确版本，不能把所有快速问题的下界，都视为一个猜想。

1511fb942c4a.en: We execute the SAT-to-orthogonal-vectors reduction on six complete finite inputs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each formula has twenty-four variables and a hundred and one clauses. Every one of the two halves’ four thousand and ninety-six vectors is retained and independently reconstructed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Orthogonal-vector search is checked with a separate native implementation. Positive pairs decode to satisfying assignments; SAT statuses are also cross-checked with native Glucose. Native UNSAT agreement is implementation evidence rather than a retained refutation proof. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each pair of half assignments corresponds to one full assignment, so the full cross-product has two to the twenty-fourth pairs. <bookmark mark='d'/> Search may stop early on positive instances. The measured times describe these specific inputs and implementations, not an exponential lower bound or an asymptotic theorem.
1511fb942c4a.zh: 我们对六份完整的有限输入，实际执行 SAT 到正交向量的归约。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 每个公式有二十四个变量、一百零一个子句。每一半的四千零九十六个向量，都被保留并独立重建。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 正交搜索用独立本地实现核对。找到的向量对可以解码为满足赋值；SAT 状态也与本地 Glucose 交叉核对。对不可满足状态的一致，是实现证据，不是保留了反证证明。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 每对半赋值对应一个完整赋值，所以全部交叉乘积包含二的二十四次方对。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 正实例搜索可能提前结束。测得耗时只描述这些具体输入和实现，不是指数下界或渐近定理。

7107298ea34e.en: The timing table uses finite negative instances with explicit certificates. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every vector in the OV fixtures shares bit sixty-three, so no orthogonal pair exists. Every integer in the 3SUM fixtures is odd, so three of them cannot sum to zero. Full inputs are retained. <bookmark mark='b'/> We report the median of thirty teaching-call intervals per size; serialization and independent checking occur outside those timers. <bookmark mark='c'/> These loops show roughly quadratic growth over the measured sizes. Fixed sixty-four-bit vectors are an implementation benchmark, distinct from growing-dimension OV hardness assumptions. <bookmark mark='d'/> Known logarithmic 3SUM improvements and future algorithmic changes must be distinguished from a fixed polynomial-exponent improvement. Conditional lower bounds are useful only within their stated models and assumptions.
7107298ea34e.zh: 计时表使用带明确证书的有限否实例。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 正交向量样本全部共享第六十三位，因此不存在正交对。三数和样本中的整数全为奇数，所以三个数不可能和为零。完整输入都被保留。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 每个规模报告三十次教学函数调用区间的中位数；序列化与独立核对都在计时之外进行。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 这些循环在测量规模上近似平方增长。固定六十四位向量是实现基准，不同于维数随规模增长的正交向量困难性假设。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 已知三数和的对数改进，以及未来算法变化，要与固定多项式指数的改进区分。条件下界只在指定模型和假设内有用。

7cfa2aed9b89.en: Parameterized algorithms separate dependence on a small parameter from dependence on the input size. <bookmark mark='a'/> For vertex cover of budget k, choose an uncovered edge. Every valid cover contains at least one endpoint, so branch on the two choices. <bookmark mark='b'/> The search tree has at most two to the k-plus-one minus one nodes. Each node still performs graph work; a small parameter does not by itself promise a practical runtime on arbitrarily large inputs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Buss’s rule forces a vertex whose degree exceeds the remaining budget. After applying it, too many remaining edges certify failure; otherwise an equivalent quadratic-size kernel remains. <bookmark mark='d'/> We retain the complete graph, cover, forced vertices, residual kernel and thirty raw timing intervals. Linear-time kernelization is a theorem about efficient implementations; this teaching routine repeatedly scans its edges.
7cfa2aed9b89.zh: 参数化算法，把对小参数的依赖与对输入规模的依赖分开。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 对预算为 k 的顶点覆盖，选择一条未覆盖边。任何有效覆盖至少包含一个端点，因此对两个选择分支。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 搜索树至多有二的 k 加一次方减一的节点。每个节点仍要处理图；参数小，并不自动保证任意大输入都能实际快速求解。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Buss 规则强制选入度数超过剩余预算的顶点。应用之后，剩余边过多可证明失败；否则保留等价的平方规模核。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 我们保留完整图、覆盖、强制顶点、剩余核和三十次原始计时。线性时间核化是针对高效实现的定理；这里的教学程序会重复扫描边。

720efbad12b7.en: Fixed-parameter tractability has a precise runtime definition. <bookmark mark='a'/> FPT means time f of k times n to a constant exponent independent of k. <bookmark mark='b'/> Vertex cover is FPT; the displayed one-point-two-seven-three-eight-to-the-k bound is a dated 2010 algorithmic example, not a verified current-record claim. <bookmark mark='c'/> Parameterized clique is W-one-hard. An FPT algorithm would collapse FPT and W-one; this does not rule out every improvement to the naive n-to-the-k enumeration. Stronger exponent barriers require stronger assumptions such as ETH. <bookmark mark='d'/> Treewidth measures how a graph can be decomposed into a tree of small overlapping bags. <bookmark mark='e'/> Courcelle’s theorem gives linear input-size dependence for each fixed monadic-second-order formula and fixed treewidth bound, with parameter-dependent constants and decomposition conditions. <bookmark mark='f'/> Colouring with a fixed palette, Hamiltonicity and independent-set variants illustrate this structural approach. Arbitrary formulas and unbounded treewidth are outside that fixed-parameter statement.
720efbad12b7.zh: 固定参数可解性有精确的运行时间定义。 <bookmark mark='a'/> FPT 指 f 作用于 k，再乘 n 的某个常数次方，而指数不能依赖 k。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 顶点覆盖属于 FPT；图中的一点二七三八的 k 次方，是带日期的二零一零年算法例子，不是已核验的最新纪录。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 参数化团是 W 一难的。若有 FPT 算法，就会使 FPT 与 W 一相等；这不排除对朴素 n 的 k 次方枚举的一切改进。更强指数障碍需要 ETH 等更强假设。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 树宽度量图能否分解成由小型重叠袋组成的树。 <bookmark mark='e'/> Courcelle 定理对每个固定的单子二阶公式和固定树宽界，给出对输入规模的线性依赖，同时带着依赖参数的常数和分解条件。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 固定调色板着色、哈密顿性和独立集变体展示这种结构方法。任意公式和无界树宽，超出了这个固定参数结论。

fa7990c61ce6.en: NP asks whether a polynomially bounded witness exists. Counting asks how many such witnesses are accepted. <bookmark mark='a'/> A number-P function counts accepting witnesses of a polynomial-time verifier under a fixed polynomial witness-length convention. <bookmark mark='b'/> For zero-one matrices, compare the determinant’s signed permutation sum with the permanent’s unsigned sum. <bookmark mark='c'/> The determinant is computable in polynomial time. Gaussian elimination has cubic arithmetic-operation complexity; integer bit complexity needs an additional size analysis. <bookmark mark='d'/> The permanent of a bipartite adjacency matrix counts perfect matchings exactly. <bookmark mark='e'/> Valiant proved that this counting problem is number-P-complete even though deciding whether a perfect matching exists is in P. <bookmark mark='f'/> This is a complexity classification, not a proof that counting requires exponential time. Such a separation would require an unproved complexity assumption.
fa7990c61ce6.zh: NP 询问是否存在多项式长度的见证；计数问题询问，有多少见证被接受。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 按固定的多项式见证长度约定，井号 P 函数计算多项式时间验证者接受的见证数量。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 对零一矩阵，比较行列式带符号的排列和，与积和式不带符号的排列和。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 行列式可以在多项式时间内求出。高斯消元有立方的算术运算次数；整数位复杂度还要分析中间数值大小。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 二分图邻接矩阵的积和式，精确计算完美匹配数量。 <bookmark mark='e'/> Valiant 证明，这个计数问题是井号 P 完全的，尽管判定完美匹配是否存在属于 P。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 这是一种复杂性分类，不是计数必须耗费指数时间的证明。这样的分离还需要未证的复杂性假设。

569bfcae0b7a.en: The measurements compare two exact integer implementations on retained random zero-one matrices. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ryser’s inclusion-exclusion formula uses exponentially many subsets with Gray-code updates. We independently check its complete integer result using a native assignment-subset dynamic program. <bookmark mark='b'/> The twenty-by-twenty matrix has the displayed exact perfect-matching count. The time is a median of thirty actual calls on this host, not a universal runtime claim. <bookmark mark='c'/> Bareiss elimination gives exact determinants, including for the retained two-hundred-by-two-hundred matrix. An independent native modular determinant plus Chinese-remainder reconstruction certifies each complete integer using a Hadamard bound. <bookmark mark='d'/> The observed growth illustrates these implementations. Increasing n by two does not force an exact factor-four wall-clock increase, and this comparison does not prove an exponential lower bound for every permanent algorithm.
569bfcae0b7a.zh: 这些测量比较两种精确整数实现，使用保留的随机零一矩阵。 <bookmark mark='a'/> Ryser 的容斥公式遍历指数数量的子集，并用 Gray 码更新。我们用独立本地赋值子集动态规划，核对完整整数结果。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 二十乘二十矩阵的完美匹配数量，是图中显示的精确整数。耗时是本机三十次实际调用的中位数，不是通用运行时间。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Bareiss 消元给出精确行列式，也包括保留的二百乘二百矩阵。独立本地模行列式与中国剩余重建，借助 Hadamard 界认证每个完整整数。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 观察到的增长展示这些实现。n 增加二，并不强迫实际时间精确变四倍；比较也没有证明所有积和式算法都需指数时间。

9e5b4e7573f9.en: Counting has striking relationships with decision and approximation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Toda’s theorem places the polynomial hierarchy inside deterministic polynomial time with a number-P oracle. We state this oracle-class inclusion without deriving a query-count refinement here. <bookmark mark='b'/> Valiant and Vazirani give randomized isolation reductions connecting SAT with the promise of a unique solution. This is not a deterministic NP-completeness claim for the unique-solution promise problem. <bookmark mark='c'/> Stockmeyer’s approximate counting uses randomness and an NP oracle to obtain a specified multiplicative accuracy with polynomial dependence on the relevant precision parameters. It is not an ordinary polynomial-time counting algorithm. <bookmark mark='d'/> Jerrum, Sinclair and Vigoda give a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for the permanent of nonnegative rational matrices, including input-bit, accuracy and failure-probability costs. <bookmark mark='e'/> Their sampling method depends on a carefully analysed Markov chain; the existence of a chain alone does not guarantee fast mixing or accurate counting. <bookmark mark='f'/> For planar graphs, Pfaffian methods count perfect matchings exactly under their specified graph and weight conventions. Structural restrictions can therefore change the counting problem substantially.
9e5b4e7573f9.zh: 计数与判定、近似之间，有引人注目的联系。 <bookmark mark='a'/> Toda 定理把多项式层级，放进可调用井号 P 谕示的确定性多项式时间。这里陈述这一谕示类包含关系，不推导查询次数的进一步改进。 <bookmark mark='b'/> Valiant 与 Vazirani 给出随机隔离归约，把 SAT 与唯一解承诺联系起来。这不是唯一解承诺问题的确定性 NP 完全性结论。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Stockmeyer 近似计数使用随机性和 NP 谕示，达到指定的乘性精度，并对相应精度参数保持多项式依赖；它不是普通多项式时间计数算法。 <bookmark mark='d'/> Jerrum、Sinclair 与 Vigoda 为非负有理数矩阵的积和式，给出完全多项式随机近似方案，同时计入输入位长、精度和失败概率成本。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 采样方法依赖仔细分析的马尔可夫链；仅仅存在一条链，并不保证快速混合或准确计数。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 对平面图，Pfaffian 方法能按指定图和权重约定，精确计算完美匹配。结构限制因此可以显著改变计数问题。

f8b80b190ea5.en: Chapter fourteen. Average case, and one-way functions.
f8b80b190ea5.zh: 第14章。平均情形与单向函数。

f6f4f7cdfa29.en: Worst-case NP-hardness does not establish average-case cryptographic hardness. Planted clique gives a specific distributional example. <bookmark mark='a'/> Generate a thousand-vertex random graph with independent fair edges, then plant a clique on a uniformly chosen vertex subset. Every actual graph and planted subset is retained. <bookmark mark='b'/> Twice the base-two logarithm of n is a rough asymptotic reference for the largest background clique. It is not a deterministic finite threshold proving uniqueness of the planted set. <bookmark mark='c'/> The degree heuristic selects high-degree vertices and applies the stated score-based cleanup. Each plotted recovery rate uses twenty actual trials, so sampling uncertainty matters. <bookmark mark='d'/> Spectral algorithms reach different size regimes under their own assumptions and success guarantees. The finite degree experiment does not establish an optimal recovery threshold. <bookmark mark='e'/> Planted-clique hardness conjectures specify the clique-size regime, distribution, recovery or detection task and computational model. <bookmark mark='f'/> Information-theoretic identifiability and efficient recoverability are different questions. We do not infer either general theorem merely from this plotted curve.
f6f4f7cdfa29.zh: 最坏情形 NP 难性，并不建立平均情形密码难度。植入团给出一个具体分布例子。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 生成千顶点随机图，每条边独立公平出现，再在均匀选择的顶点子集上植入一个团。每张实际图和植入子集都被保留。 <bookmark mark='b'/> n 的二进制对数的两倍，是背景最大团大小的粗略渐近参考，不是证明植入集合唯一性的确定有限门槛。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 度数启发式先选高度顶点，再执行指定的评分清理。图中每个恢复率来自二十次实际试验，因此抽样不确定性很重要。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 谱算法在各自假设和成功保证下，达到不同规模区间。有限的度数实验，并不建立最优恢复门槛。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 植入团困难性猜想要说明团大小区间、分布、恢复或检测任务，以及计算模型。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 信息论上能否识别，与能否高效恢复，是不同问题。不能仅凭这条曲线，就推出一般定理。

611ed6446e40.en: A one-way function must be efficiently computable yet hard for every probabilistic polynomial-time inverter on its specified random-input distribution. <bookmark mark='a'/> Success means finding any valid preimage, and the allowed success probability must be negligible as the security parameter grows. A finite timing difference is not that definition. <bookmark mark='b'/> The experiment multiplies sampled balanced primes and factors their products with bounded Brent-style rho. We retain every prime, actual product bit length, factor, raw timing and count of all modular orbit updates. <bookmark mark='c'/> The familiar fourth-root-of-the-product rho estimate assumes balanced factors and random-map heuristic behaviour. Actual trials can vary, and budget exhaustion returns no factor without a primality or hardness conclusion. <bookmark mark='d'/> More powerful factoring methods exist; dated record factorizations and this small rho implementation should not be conflated. <bookmark mark='e'/> Factoring-based one-way-function candidates require an appropriate input and preimage domain and an average-case hardness assumption. Their existence does not follow from P differing from NP alone.
611ed6446e40.zh: 单向函数必须能高效计算，同时在指定的随机输入分布上，对每个概率多项式时间求逆器都困难。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 成功指找到任何合法原像；随着安全参数增长，允许的成功概率必须可忽略。有限计时差异，并不是这个定义。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 实验把采样的平衡素数相乘，再用有预算的 Brent 式 rho 分解乘积。每个素数、实际乘积位长、因数、原始计时和全部模轨道更新次数，都被保留。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 常见的乘积四次方根估计，假设因数平衡，并使用随机映射行为的启发式模型。实际试验会变化；预算耗尽只返回没找到因数，不推出素性或困难性。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 还有更强的分解方法；带日期的分解纪录，不能与这个小型 rho 实现混同。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 基于分解的单向函数候选，需要适当的输入与原像定义，以及平均情形困难性假设。它们的存在，并不只由 P 不等于 NP 推出。

20095d74e595.en: Average-case complexity provides the bridge from algorithms to cryptographic assumptions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Levin’s distributional problems specify both a language and an efficiently samplable input distribution; the reduction must preserve the relevant average-case guarantees. <bookmark mark='b'/> Håstad, Impagliazzo, Levin and Luby showed that one-way functions imply pseudorandom generators, with the necessary quantitative reductions. <bookmark mark='c'/> Further constructions give fundamental private-key primitives. Public-key encryption requires additional capabilities and does not follow from an arbitrary one-way function by this theorem. <bookmark mark='d'/> Ajtai’s lattice results relate particular average-case problems to specified worst-case approximate lattice problems, with dimension and approximation parameters. <bookmark mark='e'/> Regev’s original LWE result uses a quantum reduction from appropriate worst-case lattice problems under its modulus and noise conditions. This is not a proof that every lattice problem or every encryption system is secure. <bookmark mark='f'/> Worst-case-to-average-case reductions from unrestricted NP-complete problems face known barriers in particular reduction models. Those barriers do not establish that cryptography is impossible.
20095d74e595.zh: 平均情形复杂性，是从算法通往密码假设的桥梁。 <bookmark mark='a'/> Levin 的分布问题同时指定语言和可高效采样的输入分布；归约必须保持相应的平均情形保证。 <bookmark mark='b'/> Håstad、Impagliazzo、Levin 与 Luby 证明单向函数推出伪随机生成器，并给出所需的定量归约。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 后续构造产生基本私钥原语。公钥加密需要附加能力，并不是这个定理从任意单向函数直接推出的。 <bookmark mark='d'/> Ajtai 的格结果，把特定平均情形问题与指定的最坏情形近似格问题联系起来，带着维数和近似参数。 <bookmark mark='e'/> Regev 原始 LWE 结果，在其模数与噪声条件下，使用从适当最坏情形格问题出发的量子归约。这不证明每个格问题或每个加密系统都安全。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 从不受限 NP 完全问题到平均情形的归约，在特定归约模型中面临已知障碍。这些障碍并不建立密码学不可能存在的结论。

734bbd65b2a7.en: Chapter fifteen. The frontier: MIP star equals RE, and proofs in practice.
734bbd65b2a7.zh: 第15章。前沿：MIP* 等于 RE，以及实践中的证明。

3478151ae140.en: These proof models give a chain of class inclusions; not every adjacent inclusion is known to be strict. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ordinary polynomial-time witness verification gives NP. <bookmark mark='b'/> Polynomial-round randomized interaction with one unbounded prover gives IP, equal to PSPACE. <bookmark mark='c'/> Multiple classical provers who cannot communicate during the protocol give MIP, equal to NEXP. Their strategies can be agreed beforehand. <bookmark mark='d'/> Entangled provers change the class dramatically. The MIP-star theorem, first announced in 2020, gives equality with the recursively enumerable languages. <bookmark mark='e'/> A classical polynomial-time verifier can check an appropriate interaction encoding halting, while the provers may need unbounded finite-dimensional resources. This does not give a uniform algorithm deciding halting; the theorem’s completeness and soundness quantifiers remain essential.
3478151ae140.zh: 这些证明模型给出一串复杂性类包含关系，并不是每对相邻包含都已知严格。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 普通多项式时间见证验证给出 NP。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 与一个不受计算限制的证明者，进行多项式轮随机交互，得到 IP，等于 PSPACE。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 多个经典证明者在协议期间不能互相通信，给出 MIP，等于 NEXP。他们可以事先约定策略。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 纠缠证明者显著改变这个类。最初于二零二零年宣布的 MIP 星定理，给出它与递归可枚举语言的相等。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 经典多项式时间验证者，能检查适当编码停机的交互，而证明者可能需要不受界限限制的有限维资源。这不提供统一的停机判定算法；完备性和可靠性的量词仍然关键。

1f7651486211.en: The result has consequences for mathematical models of quantum correlations. <bookmark mark='a'/> The verifier asks separated provers questions and tests their answer correlations. The permitted entanglement helps honest strategies but also enlarges the cheating strategies covered by soundness. <bookmark mark='b'/> The tensor-product model allows finite-dimensional entangled resources without a computable uniform dimension bound sufficient for all instances. <bookmark mark='c'/> Recursive compression links games checking games to computations of unbounded duration. We describe this architecture without reproducing the full proof. <bookmark mark='d'/> The theorem separates the closure of finite-dimensional tensor-product correlations from the commuting-operator correlation model, yielding a negative answer to the relevant Tsirelson problem. <bookmark mark='e'/> Through known equivalences it also refutes Connes’ embedding conjecture. <bookmark mark='f'/> Our source reading includes the abstract and stated consequences of the October 2026 arXiv revision. The theorem is cited from that literature, not established by this episode’s small classical simulations.
1f7651486211.zh: 这一结果影响了量子关联的数学模型。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 验证者向分开的证明者提问，再测试答案关联。允许纠缠既帮助诚实策略，也扩大了可靠性需要覆盖的作弊策略。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 张量积模型允许有限维纠缠资源，但不存在一个可计算的统一维数界，足以处理所有实例。 <bookmark mark='c'/> 递归压缩把检查另一场博弈的博弈，与无界持续时间的计算联系起来。这里只描述架构，不重现完整证明。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 定理分离有限维张量积关联集合的闭包，与交换算子关联模型，从而对相应的 Tsirelson 问题给出否定答案。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 通过已知等价，它还反驳 Connes 嵌入猜想。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 我们的来源阅读包括二零二六年十月 arXiv 修订版的摘要和所述推论。定理引用自文献，不是由本部分的小型经典模拟建立的。

51275569583b.en: Practical proof systems combine several ingredients with distinct security assumptions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Arithmetize a specified bounded computation into field constraints. Some systems use sum-check or related interactive oracle proofs to reduce verification work. <bookmark mark='b'/> Commitments bind the prover to the relevant polynomials or oracles; the commitment scheme determines important assumptions and costs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Fiat–Shamir removes interaction only for suitable protocols under an appropriate analysis, often in a random-oracle model. A fixed real hash is an instantiation rather than an unconditional theorem. <bookmark mark='d'/> Groth16 has constant-size proofs in group elements under its algebraic assumptions and structured setup. Transparent systems use different assumptions and typically different proof-size trade-offs. <bookmark mark='e'/> Validity rollups can aggregate transaction verification into such arguments; optimistic rollups follow a different dispute-based mechanism. <bookmark mark='f'/> A zkVM proves a bounded execution according to an encoded machine and constraints. Zero knowledge is an additional property and must not be inferred from succinctness alone. <bookmark mark='g'/> Proof size and verifier work depend on the system, security parameters and public input. Prover overhead can be substantial. None of our small teaching protocols is presented as a deployed secure proof system.
51275569583b.zh: 实用证明系统结合多种组成部分，而各自的安全假设不同。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 把指定的有界计算算术化成域约束。有些系统使用 sum-check 或相关交互式谕示证明，减少验证工作。 <bookmark mark='b'/> 承诺使证明者受相关多项式或谕示约束；承诺方案决定重要假设和成本。 <bookmark mark='c'/> Fiat–Shamir 只在适当分析下，为合适协议去掉交互，常在随机谕示模型中讨论。固定真实哈希是一种实例化，并非无条件定理。 <bookmark mark='d'/> Groth16 在代数假设和结构化设置下，有固定数量群元素组成的证明。透明系统使用不同假设，通常也有不同证明大小权衡。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 有效性 Rollup 可以用这些论证聚合交易验证；乐观 Rollup 使用另一种基于争议的机制。 <bookmark mark='f'/> zkVM 按编码机器和约束，证明一次有界执行。零知识是附加性质，不能只从简洁性推出。 <bookmark mark='g'/> 证明大小与验证工作，取决于系统、安全参数和公开输入。证明者开销可能很大。这里没有把任何小型教学协议，当作已部署的安全证明系统。

b66eb5f5aa17.en: Here are the broader questions behind the examples. <bookmark mark='a'/> Does randomness increase the power of polynomial-time computation, and what new hardness results would derandomization imply? <bookmark mark='b'/> What is the status of the precise near-satisfiable Unique Games promise? <bookmark mark='c'/> How do the stated variants of SETH, 3SUM and APSP relate through fine-grained reductions? We do not assert an equivalence between them. <bookmark mark='d'/> Over a suitable field, such as characteristic zero, does the permanent require superpolynomial arithmetic circuits? Characteristic two is different because signs vanish and permanent equals determinant. <bookmark mark='e'/> Can useful average-case cryptographic hardness be derived from standard worst-case assumptions through suitable reductions? The reduction model matters. <bookmark mark='f'/> How do exact local-test soundness bounds behave as the dimension grows? Our exhaustive four-bit BLR computation settles only that finite domain. <bookmark mark='g'/> The research exercise starts with complete finite witnesses, then asks which general patterns can actually be proved.
b66eb5f5aa17.zh: 这些例子背后，还有更广的问题。 <bookmark mark='a'/> 随机性是否增加多项式时间计算能力，去随机化又会推出哪些新难度结果？ <bookmark mark='b'/> 精确的近乎可满足唯一博弈承诺，处于什么状态？ <bookmark mark='c'/> 指定版本的 SETH、三数和与全对最短路，如何通过细粒度归约联系？这里不宣称它们等价。 <bookmark mark='d'/> 在特征零等适当域上，积和式是否需要超多项式算术电路？特征二不同，因为符号消失，积和式等于行列式。 <bookmark mark='e'/> 能否通过适当归约，从标准最坏情形假设推出有用的平均情形密码难度？归约模型很重要。 <bookmark mark='f'/> 随着维数增长，精确局部测试可靠性界如何变化？四位 BLR 穷举只解决了这个有限定义域。 <bookmark mark='g'/> 研究习题先保留完整有限见证，再追问哪些一般规律确实可以被证明。

83fbd36da366.en: This part built executable examples of amplification, fingerprints, random restrictions, interactive proofs and sum-check; checked salted-hash commitments and opened-colour marginals; explored PCP and approximation theorems, unique games, fine-grained and parameterized algorithms; and compared exact counting with average-case experiments. Full finite inputs, models and transcripts support the measurements. Theorems retain their model, completeness, soundness and security assumptions. A marginal simulator histogram and a small hash-challenge demonstration do not independently establish cryptographic security.
83fbd36da366.zh: 本部分构建了放大、指纹、随机限制、交互式证明和 sum-check 的可执行例子；检查带盐哈希承诺与打开颜色的边缘分布；探索 PCP、近似、唯一博弈、细粒度和参数化算法；并比较精确计数与平均情形实验。完整有限输入、模型和对话记录支撑这些测量。定理仍保留模型、完备性、可靠性和安全假设。边缘分布模拟直方图与小型哈希挑战演示，不能独立建立密码安全。

8a552c962571.en: Where this returns: Part 28 develops error-correcting codes and local testing; Part 29 studies pseudorandom generators and one-way functions; Part 30 develops suitable identification, signature, lattice and succinct-argument constructions with their assumptions. Part 53 studies quantum entanglement; Part 56 returns to expanders; Part 57 connects learning hardness with specified computational assumptions. Each connection uses a precise construction rather than a universal conversion between proof systems.
8a552c962571.zh: 这些内容会再次出现：第28部分研究纠错码与局部测试，第29部分研究伪随机生成器和单向函数，第30部分在各自假设下，发展适当的身份识别、签名、格和简洁论证构造。第53部分研究量子纠缠，第56部分回到扩展图，第57部分把学习难度与指定计算假设联系起来。每种联系使用精确构造，而不是证明系统之间的普遍转换。

0a2113e953f5.en: In practice, choose the object and guarantee first. Fingerprints need a length, field or hash model and an error bound. Succinct verification needs a specified computation and proof-system assumptions. Zero knowledge needs a simulator-based definition for the full verifier view. Fine-grained lower bounds apply conditionally to their exact input and machine models. Parameterized methods trade parameter dependence against input-size work; a small kernel and measured implementation costs help decide whether that trade is useful.
0a2113e953f5.zh: 实践中，先选定对象和保证。指纹需要长度、域或哈希模型，以及错误界。简洁验证需要指定计算和证明系统假设。零知识需要针对验证者完整视图的模拟器定义。细粒度下界有条件地适用于精确的输入和机器模型。参数化方法权衡参数依赖与输入规模工作；小规模核与实测实现成本，帮助判断这种权衡是否有用。

2da3911e3660.en: Six exercises connect the definitions with complete finite checks. Prove amplification and the deterministic equality lower bound. Prove sum-check soundness using conditional probabilities, and verify Buss’s kernel argument. Build the transcript-bound hash-challenge demonstration for the structured twenty-variable formula, with canonical serialization, domain separation, uniform challenges and explicit mutation checks; it is not a general security proof. Finally compare all sixty-five thousand five hundred and thirty-six four-bit Boolean functions with the exact BLR minima and inspect witnesses before proposing a higher-dimensional theorem.
2da3911e3660.zh: 六道习题把定义与完整有限检查联系起来。证明放大和确定性相等判定下界。用条件概率证明 sum-check 可靠性，并核对 Buss 核论证。为结构化的二十变量公式，构建绑定对话记录的哈希挑战演示，使用规范序列化、域分离、均匀挑战和明确的篡改检查；它不是一般安全证明。最后，比较全部六万五千五百三十六个四位布尔函数的精确 BLR 最小值，先检查见证，再提出更高维定理。

7db4fe070dde.en: Next time: errors. In 1947 Richard Hamming's weekend jobs kept dying on bad bits, so he taught the machine to fix them. Polynomials, the same ones that powered sum-check, become codes that survive scratches. Claude Shannon proved how much noise costs, and it took fifty years to reach his limit. We will scratch a QR code and recover its message. Part 28, Error-Correcting Codes.
7db4fe070dde.zh: 下一次：错误。1947年，Richard Hamming 的周末作业总因坏位而死掉，于是他教机器去纠正它们。多项式，正是驱动 sum-check 的那些，变成了能经受划痕的编码。Claude Shannon 证明了噪声的代价有多大，而人们花了五十年才达到他的极限。我们会划花一个二维码，再把它的信息找回来。第28部分，纠错码。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
